_comment: Describes this release to other installs. Read by the Version & Updates panel when an operator points their server at a URL serving this file. Generated from releases/<version>.md by scripts/build-release-json.js — edit the notes file, not this one.
notes: Everything in this release is about *getting the Android app built and downloaded*, plus the app's launcher icon. There is no database change, no breaking change, and nothing about how your photos are stored or served. On a Docker install the headline is that building an APK no longer needs an image rebuild: `compose.yaml` mounts the APK directory into the API, so a build is downloadable the moment it finishes. The builder image also carried the wrong Android platform, which made every build fail inside Gradle at the last step; that is fixed. Rebuild your APK if you want the new launcher icon. It is a proper adaptive icon now, instead of a square bitmap that each launcher crops to its own shape.
